import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/capital_planning/change_history?search=SOME_STRING_VALUE&date_to=SOME_STRING_VALUE&date_from=SOME_STRING_VALUE&changed%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&actor_id%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&project_id%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE&per_page=SOME_NUMBER_VALUE&page=SOME_NUMBER_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
